scoring_justification: Recomputation from raw DFT output (total energies, NEB images) is not feasible within the lightweight verifier sandbox; comparing the agent's computed final numbers to the paper's gold with threshold_or_better tolerances is the appropriate tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for Na binding energies and diffusion barriers
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 and text: Eb bulk Si +0.60 eV, polysilane -0.57 eV, silicene -0.32 eV; barriers from text: bulk Si 1.06 eV, polysilane 0.41 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper; embedded inline in grading_spec.json.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported results, which serve as the reproduction target. The agent must compute them independently.

outputs.description: Na binding energies (Eb) for Na in bulk Si, layered polysilane, and single-layer H-passivated silicene, and Na diffusion barriers in bulk Si and layered polysilane. All values in eV.

output_contract.notes: Binding energies are defined per Na atom as Eb = [E(Na-Si) - E(Si) - E(Na)]. Diffusion barriers are obtained via CI-NEB. Scoring is per-field with independent thresholds and tolerances; more negative binding energies and lower barriers earn full credit.
